name: bjango
description: Bjango — The Gritty Western. Cinematic mobile ricochet shooter.

scripts.test: node tests/physics.test.js && node tests/levels.test.js && node --test tests/features.test.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home} ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./Bjango-debug.apk
scripts.bundle:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home} ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd .. && python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.copy('android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab','Bjango-release.aab'); shutil.copy('Bjango-release.aab','PlayStore_Assets/Bjango-release.aab')"
